summary: The customer, David, called Metro Utilities requesting a payment extension on his upcoming bill due to unexpected expenses. The agent, Sarah, verified the account, checked the customer's payment history, and successfully extended the due date to October 26th.

evidence.text: I have successfully updated your new due date to October twenty-sixth.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Extend the bill due date to October 26th.

evidence.text: Thank you for calling Metro Utilities, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
evidence.speaker: Agent

evidence.text: I understand, David, and I'd be happy to check your account for extension options today.
